summary:
Will the palm oil trade continue to be a source of
employment for newbuilding MRs? Since 2000, palm oil exports have increased from 16.6 million metric tons (MT) to an estimated 44.6 million MT in 2014 - an impressive compound annual growth rate of 7.3%. Supply and demand developments in this trade point to continued growth until at least 2020.
